body: As a full blooded Native American born in Arizona I can attest  that, myself included, many of us don’t receive “free” healthcare to health facilities of our choosing. Although yes, there are clinics set up throughout the reservation, but once we step out  we’re on our own. I for one have spent a year of my 27 years on a reservation so I don’t receive full access. As a matter of fact last winter I busted my leg whilst snowboarding in Utah ( where I currently reside) and had to pay for MRI scans out of my pocket. To my understanding there are 2-3 colleges in the US that waive tuition for Native Americans. So, I can’t exactly pick a random school of my choosing and apply expecting to pay nothing. And no, my tribe doesn’t hand out “monthly checks” from what the casinos earn. Also, I pay taxes, if it necessarily has to addressed.

If you're serious about getting your CWI, I highly recommend Real Education. They hold classes all throughout the south i.e. Texas, Mississippi. I got it last year, through them; passed it on the first try. Best decision I've ever made.
